summary: The PrfEmailMessages functionality is part of the HSPnet.UserControls.StaffProfile namespace. It manages staff messages through an interface that supports viewing, adding, editing, and deleting messages. The interface includes various controls like grids, panels, and buttons to manage these operations.
purpose: To facilitate the management of email messages for staff profiles within the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: Manage Staff Messages
steps: PreRender: Adjust visibility and command name of save button based on mode
ItemInserting: Validate page and setup TypeCodeID
ItemUpdating: Validate page and setup ID and TypeCodeID
dsStaffMessagesID: Selecting, Updating, and Inserting based on UserSession

validations: Ensure that the page is valid before inserting or updating items
If UserSession is null in selecting methods, cancel the operation
conditions: Check if uxDetail.Row and uxDetail.DataItem are not null
Check if ScreenIsEditable to show or hide certain UI elements
Check if GridView gv rows count is zero and ScreenIsEditable to show pnlEmptyData
system_behavior: Use AjaxControlToolkit and System.Web.UI controls to manage the interface
Auto-generate fields and require modifications in code-behind files for changes
Redirects user to the current page after certain actions
exceptions: If UserSession is null, operations related to staff messages are canceled
JavaScript errors related to event validation caused by EmptyDataTemplate
